stem: Per Rule 030101, what must all officers undergo on joining the Service, in addition to passing the prescribed confirmation examination?

options.A: Direct enrollment in the National Youth Service Corps
options.B: An induction training course
options.C: A separate certification exam administered by their state government
options.D: A one-year secondment abroad

explanation: Rule 030101(i): all officers on joining the Service shall undergo an induction training course, in addition to passing the prescribed confirmation examination.

stem: Per Rule 030105, within how long from taking up their appointment must all officers take the confirmation examination?

options.A: Within three years
options.B: Within six months
options.D: Within one year

stem: Under Rule 030105, what happens to an officer who fails to take the confirmation examination at all within three years of their first appointment?

options.B: They are given one final one-year extension before any consequence
options.C: They are automatically confirmed without needing to sit the exam
options.D: They shall be required to resign from the service

explanation: Rule 030105: an officer who fails to take the confirmation examination after 3 years of first appointment shall be required to resign from the service.

stem: Per Rule 030107, is an officer generally allowed to consult reference books such as the Public Service Rules during the confirmation examination?

options.C: Yes, except for the General Paper, Office Procedure/Routine, or Special Paper components
options.D: No, except for Police and Para-Military officers, who may use them freely

explanation: Rule 030107: reference is allowed to Public Service reference books, but textbooks/reference books are not allowed for the General Paper, Office Procedure/Routine, or Special Paper.

stem: Under Rule 030302, what happens to a Clerical Officer on GL.04 whose examination performance is exceptional ('accelerated level')?
